Default.howToPlay1Text: Each round, each team's Encryptor receives a secret 3-digit code (e.g. 2-4-1). They give one word clue per digit — each clue should hint at the numbered word in the team's word list.
Default.howToPlay2Text:
Decoders: after hearing the clues, click the 3 word slots to guess your own team's code. You'll also try to intercept the enemy's code!

Break (correct intercept) = +1 break. Botch (wrong self-decode) = -1 life.

First team with 2 breaks wins! 2 botches and you lose.
